FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R01 | anchor: A03
A downhill-parked car has its front wheels rolled toward the curb so the curb blocks rolling, while an uphill-parked car with a curb has them rolled away from the curb [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint hill-parking; prereq_hint curb parking basics; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R02
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R02 | anchor: A04
Uphill parking where no curb exists calls for steering the front wheels toward the road edge instead of away from it [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint hill-parking; prereq_hint sec08-basic-driving-R01; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R01
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R03 | anchor: A04
A car parked beside a curb must keep its back wheel within a foot of the curb, and a parallel-parked car must finish within a foot of the curb [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint parking-position; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R04
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0043]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R04 | anchor: A03
Utah bars parking within fifteen feet of a hydrant, within twenty feet of a crosswalk, within thirty feet of a beacon or sign or signal, and within fifty feet of the closest rail of a crossing [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint no-parking-zones; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R03
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0042]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R05 | anchor: A05
A driver returning after a pass must be at least two hundred feet clear of approaching traffic before moving back right [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint passing; prereq_hint lane-change checks; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R06
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R06 | anchor: A05
A motorist near a snowplow showing flashing yellow lamps must not pass on the side where the blade is out, and must not pass at all when three or more plows run in echelon [A05].
Why it matters: group_hint passing-exceptions; prereq_hint sec08-basic-driving-R05; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R05
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0044]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R07 | anchor: A07
Traffic in both directions must halt for a bus flashing red lamps on a two-lane road or a four-lane road without a median, while only the same-direction lanes must halt on a divided highway or a five-lane road with a shared center turn lane [A07].
Why it matters: group_hint school-bus-stops; prereq_hint stopping basics; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R08
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R08 | anchor: A06
At a railroad crossing with flashing signals, gates, a watchman, or a stop sign, the driver must halt farther than fifteen feet but no farther than fifty feet from the nearest rail [A06].
Why it matters: group_hint stopping; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R07
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0045]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R09 | anchor: A09
A forward two-point turn enters a driveway or alley first and then backs out, while a reverse two-point turn drives past the driveway and then backs into it [A09].
Why it matters: group_hint turnarounds; prereq_hint signaling and head checks; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R10
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R10 | anchor: A09
A three-point turn belongs only on a narrow two-lane road, and a U-turn is barred where sight distance falls short of five hundred feet both ways, on curves and hilltops, tracks, crossings, freeways, and posted no-U-turn spots [A09].
Why it matters: group_hint turnarounds; prereq_hint sec08-basic-driving-R09; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R09
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R11 | anchor: A01
A lane change calls for mirrors first, a signal held at least two seconds, an over-shoulder blind-spot look, and a signal cancel after merging [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint lane-changes; prereq_hint signaling basics; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R12
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0040]

FACT_ID: sec08-basic-driving-R12 | anchor: A02
A merging driver must yield to nearby through-lane traffic and must not enter the solid-white gore zone, while at a jammed merge point drivers use the full lanes and take turns under the zipper method [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint merging; prereq_hint sec08-basic-driving-R11; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec08-basic-driving-R11
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0041]
